description: Defines Backbone.Marionette views for TodoMVC application, including Todo item view, list view body, and list view with filtering and toggle functionality.

classes.name: TodoMVC.TodoView
classes.description: View for individual todo item, handles display, editing, toggling, and deletion.

classes.name: TodoMVC.ListViewBody
classes.description: Collection view for list of todo items, supports filtering.

classes.name: TodoMVC.ListView
classes.description: Main list view managing the collection, toggle all, and rendering.

methods.name: deleteModel
methods.description: Destroys the model associated with the view.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completed state of the model and saves.

methods.name: onEditClick
methods.description: Enters editing mode for the todo item.

methods.name: onEditFocusout
methods.description: Saves the edited title or deletes the item if empty.

methods.name: onEditKeypress
methods.description: Handles keypress events for editing (Enter or Escape).

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters child views based on current filter state.

methods.name: setCheckAllState
methods.description: Sets the toggle all checkbox based on collection's completed items.

methods.name: onToggleAllClick
methods.description: Sets all todo items to completed or active based on toggle.

methods.name: onRender
methods.description: Renders the list view and its child view.
